name: Mateo Rodriguez
bio:
Mateo Rodriguez's journey into motorsport began with a fascination for the raw power and precision of Formula 1, fueled by watching races with his grandfather as a child. After completing his degree in Human Resources, Mateo saw an opportunity to combine his professional skills with his passion. He started in a local karting team, managing their personnel and developing training programs. 

His meticulous approach and dedication to fostering a positive team environment caught the eye of Erebus Motorsport. Now, as their HR Manager, Mateo focuses on recruiting and retaining top talent, ensuring that the team is not only skilled but also cohesive and motivated. He believes in creating a supportive workplace where every team member feels valued and can contribute their best work, pushing Erebus Motorsport to achieve its full potential. 

Mateo is particularly skilled at conflict resolution and is known for his ability to mediate disputes fairly and efficiently, maintaining harmony within the team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave.
physical.description: Mateo is of average height, with a thoughtful expression and kind eyes.

quirks: Always has a thermos of mate tea on his desk.
Memorizes everyone's birthday and celebrates with a small gesture.
Keeps a small toy car on his desk as a reminder of his passion for motorsport.
